title: Simplify Filter Preset admin flow
description: Reduce the visible preset form to the concepts implementers need first and move provider/runtime details to advanced sections.
objective: Make the Filter Presets page explain itself quickly: create reusable filter behavior, add filter rows, then edit layout and styling in Elementor through the bridge.
expected_outputs: Preset list and form copy use practical wording instead of internal provider language.
Main form presents identity, Elementor bridge, filter rows, and essentials first.
Provider, selectors, query vars, compare, data type, and text overrides move into advanced details.
Filter rows can be dynamically added and removed in the browser.
Existing saved presets keep the same option schema.
acceptance_criteria: A new preset page has an obvious Add filter action.
Provider mode is not a first-glance field.
Target/item selectors are explained as widget/Elementor override defaults, not as the main workflow.
Saved preset data remains compatible with FilterController::resolve_preset_settings.
verification: WP-CLI smoke saves a preset with multiple filters.
Browser smoke checks add-filter creates additional inputs and bridge panel is visible.
MCP validate_task for TASK-016 returned valid.
WP-CLI smoke saved a preset with three filters.
Browser smoke changed filter rows from 1 to 2 and confirmed Provider Mode is not first-glance copy.

budgets.scope_budget: visible admin flow and repeaters only
budgets.validation_budget: MCP plus WP-CLI smoke plus browser smoke

risks: Moving fields into details could hide advanced capabilities from power users if labels are unclear.
The preset admin can still become a configuration wall if too many JetSmartFilters-like options are added at once.
